verdict.rationale: Docs show that Oneleet supports multiple frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR) under one platform and that controls are shared across frameworks — removing a framework only strips controls not needed by another framework, implying shared evidence/control reuse. However, there's no explicit documentation of an 'overlap view' or reporting that shows which SOC 2 work directly maps to ISO 27001/HIPAA requirements. Missing for 10: explicit UI/feature showing cross-framework overlap percentages or mapping, evidence of automatic reuse when adding a second framework (not just removal logic), and any hands-on/independent confirmation.
